_comment: Traditional Chinese texts for the German table fan_inkshadow. Keys are the English text; keys with %s or %d are patterns. Kept by hand; check with python3 tools/i18n/check_lang.py zh_TW.

strings.%s counts the fence posts. Twice. One is: %s數籬笆樁。數了兩遍。少了一根。
strings.%s digs up a few coins and drops them at: %s刨出幾枚硬幣丟在你腳邊。%d金幣！
strings.%s eats something off the path. It seems: %s吃了路上的什麼東西。看起來沒事。大概。
%s瞪著一叢灌木，好像它欠了錢。
%s躲在你靴子後面，躲一片葉子。
%s跟上步伐，平靜得像一口合上的棺材。
strings.%s mutters the names of everyone you let: %s唸叨著你讓倒下的每個名字。你的也在名單上。
strings.%s nods at strangers as if they owe it a: %s朝陌生人點頭，好像他們欠它一個鞠躬。
strings.%s plants its feet. Nothing is attacking: %s站穩腳跟。沒人進攻。它還是站穩了。
strings.%s runs ahead, runs back, and pretends i: %s跑到前面，又跑回來，假裝從沒離開。
strings.%s sniffs a grave marker and looks very: %s嗅了嗅一塊墓碑，看上去非常感興趣。
strings.%s steps on your heel. Twice. On purpose: %s踩了你的腳後跟。兩次。故意的。
strings.%s steps on your shadow so nobody sees i: %s踩住你的影子，好讓別人看不見。
strings.%s struts like it won the last battle al: %s昂首闊步，好像上一場是它獨自打贏的。
%s跟在你身後有點太近了。像刀一樣。
strings.%s walks exactly in your footprints, jus: %s完全踩著你的腳印走，以防萬一。
